records.locator: Sanidad Militar 74(3), printed p. 180 (Methods and Results), p. 181 (Table 4), Discussion and reference 20
records.evidence_note: The clinical tables contain three treated referrals after chamber hypoxia exercises, with two diagnoses of DCS and one of pulmonary overexpansion. A separate DCS referral is from operational parachuting. The three chamber referrals are the denominator of the diagnostic proportion only. No trainee or staff person-exposure risk set is reported. The Discussion explicitly cites Ríos-Tejada et al. for the pulmonary-overexpansion event.

No case crosswalk is available. The chapter was presented in October 2000 and published in the 2001 proceedings.
